description: Representative card dataset for the Personal AI Anki Builder. NOT a copy of the user's real cards. Each entry follows style-guide.md and passes quality-checklist.md. Pronoun distribution per style-guide §4 (60% I / 20% We / 10% You / 10% Other) targets a 10-card batch: 6 I, 2 We, 1 You, 1 Other. Every example satisfies the 30-day rule and is reusable across conversations. Cloze field uses literal ______ underscore fill-in-the-blank (matching the user's existing 'English Active Recall' model, which is a regular Question/Answer template, not an Anki Cloze type).

cards.meaning: to continue doing something despite difficulties or to follow a plan or principle
cards.example: I need to stick to my coding routine even when I don't feel motivated.
cards.cloze: I need to ______ my coding routine even when I don't feel motivated.
cards.rationale: Personal habit card. Reusable across any check-in conversation. Subject is the user (I) — matches share target. Within 30 days: yes, this is a daily cadence check.

cards.meaning: to find and fix errors in code or a system
cards.example: I need to debug this race condition before we ship the patch.
cards.cloze: I need to ______ this race condition before we ship the patch.
cards.rationale: Pure cluster A. Sentence the user would literally say this sprint. Reusable: drop-in phrase for any standup or PR review.

cards.meaning: to produce an idea, plan, or solution when one is needed
cards.example: We need to come up with a better strategy for our weekly code reviews.
cards.cloze: We need to ______ a better strategy for our weekly code reviews.
cards.rationale: We-pronoun card. Real team artifact (weekly code reviews). Generic enough to drop into any planning meeting conversation.

cards.meaning: to create something strong through effort or to shape metal with heat
cards.example: I forged a small CLI tool that saves me time every morning.
cards.cloze: I ______ a small CLI tool that saves me time every morning.
cards.rationale: Past-tense forge framed as recent accomplishment. Cluster D (personal projects). Reusable: 'I forged X' works for anything you build.

cards.meaning: in a regular or even manner; without sudden changes
cards.example: I trained steadily for six months before hitting my first deadlift PR.
cards.cloze: I trained ______ for six months before hitting my first deadlift PR.
cards.rationale: Cluster F (body/gym). Sentence reusable in any gym conversation: 'I've been training steadily'.

cards.meaning: not willing to do something; hesitant even when expected to act
cards.example: You don't have to feel reluctant to ask for help when you're stuck on a problem.
cards.cloze: You don't have to feel ______ to ask for help when you're stuck on a problem.
cards.rationale: You-pronoun card. Generic advice the user could give in a 1:1 or slack thread. Reusable as a coaching phrase.

cards.meaning: a setting that automatically continues a subscription or contract without manual action
cards.example: I forgot to cancel the auto-renewal on a SaaS subscription I stopped using.
cards.cloze: I forgot to cancel the ______ on a SaaS subscription I stopped using.
cards.rationale: Every user with subscriptions hits this. Reusable in any finance/admin conversation.

cards.meaning: to stay at the same level or pace as someone or something
cards.example: I watch English podcasts to keep up with how people talk in real meetings.
cards.cloze: I watch English podcasts to ______ with how people talk in real meetings.
cards.rationale: Cluster C (English learning). Anchored in a habit the user is already doing. Sentence reusable when talking about how the user learns English.

cards.meaning: to fill time or attention, or to take and hold a space
cards.example: We let one tiny bug occupy the entire morning before we found the real issue.
cards.cloze: We let one tiny bug ______ the entire morning before we found the real issue.
cards.rationale: We-pronoun card. Cluster A. Reusable in any postmortem conversation: 'X occupied the whole morning'.

cards.meaning: to do something very well; to succeed at a task in a complete way
cards.example: The team totally nailed the demo and landed three new clients that day.
cards.cloze: The team totally ______ the demo and landed three new clients that day.
cards.rationale: Other pronoun ('The team') — fills the 10% slot. Reusable as a celebration phrase in any retrospective or wrap-up.

checks_passed: Q47 template uniqueness: no two consecutive cards share skeleton
Q48 cluster coverage: Cluster A (5 cards) and Cluster C (1 card) both present
